planner.description: Real Planner invocation for plan generation

executor.description: Real Executor invocations — Pilot C MUST have E>=2 (initial + rework)

reviewer.description: Real Reviewer invocation for code review

evaluator.description: Real Evaluator invocation for success assessment

rework.description: Real rework evidence — MUST have Verification FAIL or Reviewer ChangesRequested + second Executor invocation

critical_rules: Pilot C E<2 MUST FAIL — regardless of aggregate counts
Pilot C rework=0 MUST FAIL — even if E>=2 (no real rework evidence)
Rework must be real: Verification FAIL or Reviewer ChangesRequested → second Executor invocation

rework_evidence_source.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM execution_attempts WHERE lifecycle = 'completed' AND profile_id != 'deterministic' AND attempt_number > 1
rework_evidence_source.rationale: attempt_number > 1 indicates a task was re-executed after initial failure or rework request

independent_evaluation.note: Pilot C is evaluated ONLY on its own DB (pilot-c/harness.db). E<2 or rework=0 means FAIL regardless of other pilot counts.
